method_references.source: Hastie, Tibshirani & Friedman (2009), The Elements of Statistical Learning, 2nd ed.
method_references.supports: Separate coefficient/model selection from assessment; repeat selection within validation; squared-error loss; resampling for stability.
method_references.does_not_support: No direct justification of our numerical budgets, sample size, coefficients, interval minimax objective or a calibrated probability interpretation.

method_references.source: OECD/JRC (2008), Handbook on Constructing Composite Indicators
method_references.reading_scope: Official metadata and prior recorded excerpts, not full book read in this experiment.
method_references.supports: Composite weighting must expose assumptions and sensitivity; not an authority for particular coefficients.

not_a_registered_study: Protocol committed before new collection; no claim of registry preregistration.
coefficient_evidence: Coefficients must be estimated from this batch; no cited work dictates them.
